about_the_game:
ChimpUP! is a chaotic co-op climbing racing game where you and your friends try to gather mysterious bananas. Armed with two independent grapple hooks for arms, you and up to three other chimp friends compete in races across a fast paced maps with gimmicks. Master the swing action, collect the bananas and satisfy your urge!

RACE TO THE TOP

Speed is Everything! Compete against your friends in rapid-fire 30-second races where every map has a weird gimmick. Finish first to earn points, then immediately launch into the next course without missing a beat. First chimp to reach the target score claims victory.

DOUBLE GRAPPLE HOOK

Two Arms, Infinite Possibilities: Each of your arms is an independent grappling hook, giving you complete control over your climbing style. Alternate between arms for steady climbing, or use both simultaneously for explosive momentum swings. The maps are your playground, it's up to you to master the technique!

SABOTAGE YOUR FRIENDS

All's Fair in Chimp Racing: Why climb fair when you can climb dirty? Grab your friends mid-swing to throw them off course, or knock them loose at the worst possible moment. Be a nightmare!

EXPRESS YOURSELF

Customize your chimp with unique cosmetics and create your own identity on the mountain. Even if you can’t collect any bananas, make sure you outshine them all with fashion!

IN-GAME COSMETIC AND MAP EDITOR

Design custom maps with unique challenges and gimmicks, or craft original cosmetics to share with the community!

PLAY YOUR WAY

Not into competition? You can tweak the game settings all you want, from chill solo climbing sessions to custom rule sets with friends.

DEMO FEATURES

  • 4-player competitive co-op racing

  • Dual independent grapple hook controls

  • 30-second average map completion for fast-paced action

  • Score-based competition across multiple maps per session

  • Player grabbing and sabotage mechanics

  • Character customization

  • Detailed race settings for customized play

  • Online co-op and single player
